messaging.short: Markdown knowledge base that gives agents the decisions behind code
messaging.meta: Wordcell keeps decisions, plans, and sources as Markdown beside your code, so coding agents can find them from the file they are about to change.
messaging.medium: Wordcell keeps decisions, plans, and sources as Markdown files beside your code. Coding agents find them by exact words, by meaning with an optional local model, or from the file they are about to change.
messaging.long: A new coding-agent session can read your code, but not the decisions that stayed in the last session's chat. Wordcell keeps those decisions as Markdown files beside the repository, with the plans that depend on them and the web pages and PDFs that informed them. Tie a note to the paths it explains, and an agent about to change that code runs one command to get the notes and plans for that path. Exact search, backlinks, and Git history run on your machine with no account or model, and every index rebuilds from files you can read in any editor. Wordcell is free and open source.

relations.label: exports private bundles
relations.detail: GhostGet produces bounded multi-account Beeper bundles that TextButler verifies and ingests locally.

relations.label: provider transport
relations.detail: PeopleBlade uses GhostGet to read contacts and search results from connected accounts such as Beeper and WhatsApp, and checks each result before saving it locally.

relations.label: shared bundle format
relations.detail: Both tools implement the versioned message-like-me.local-message-bundle interchange without importing each other's private state.

relations.label: compacts sessions for
relations.detail: Excalibur (xcb) uses Gobstopper's elision policy to drop stale tool output from Claude Code and Codex prompts once context passes a threshold, and keeps the original output in local history. It is on by default.

relations.label: exports sessions for
relations.detail: Excalibur (xcb) measures subscription usage locally and, when you turn on exports, writes session files in the aicharts format. Automatic upload is not available.

relations.label: exports dossier packets
relations.detail: Soulscrape exports dated dossier packets that PeopleBlade imports and rebinds to contacts during local merge review.

relations.label: README-backed /direct
relations.detail: Hraness renders the pinned public Direct README and Agent Skill at /direct.

relations.label: publishes kernel specification
relations.detail: The public Oh site publishes the versioned specification for the @hraness/oh kernel from the same repository.

relations.label: OAuth protocol
relations.detail: The public Suite Accounts package validates the protocol spoken by products and the Accounts authority.

relations.label: drafts replies through
relations.detail: TextButler can classify messages and draft replies through Excalibur (xcb) on the Claude Code or Codex subscription you already pay for, with xcb holding the sign-in; a separately billed API route also exists.

relations.label: runs reply habitats on
relations.detail: TextButler's opt-in per-contact habitats run as ALGAL programs: a candidate reply plan replaces the current one only after a blind replay shows no regression, and no plan can change the recipient, provider, or permissions.

relations.label: keeps its hosted library's agent working memory in
relations.detail: Sponge's hosted library at sponge.computer keeps its research agents' working memory in a server-side Oh store, separate from the reviewed knowledge in its product database.

relations.label: answers graph queries with
relations.detail: Wordcell rebuilds a disposable Oh graph from your Markdown to answer named graph queries with source proofs; Markdown and Git stay the record, and search does not use Oh's memory retrieval.

relations.label: replays task history with
relations.detail: Excalibur (xcb) embeds the ALGAL runtime for task transitions, route and settle reflexes, and resumable controllers, and its task verifier replays a task's recorded history offline; the managed harness is experimental.

relations.label: searches project notes with
relations.detail: Excalibur (xcb) can bind one explicit Wordcell vault through a hash-pinned CLI, giving workers a read-only memory search with citations; saving a note back to the vault is always an explicit step.

relations.label: scores puzzles with
relations.detail: Clankdar's default puzzles are small programs in ALGAL's expression language, and ALGAL's official evaluator, pinned by commit and hash, computes each reference answer, so no judge model decides.

relations.label: bakes character behavior with
relations.detail: SlopCamera's scene behavior bake runs character behavior as ALGAL organisms with no executors or side effects.

relations.label: captures signed-in pages through
relations.detail: Sponge captures signed-in pages through GhostGet, storing only a login name, and the hosted library at sponge.computer imports GhostGet's text-only capture bundles offline.

relations.label: imports research exchanges into its hosted library from
relations.detail: Sponge's hosted library at sponge.computer converts a public Soulscrape research exchange offline into an Oh research packet that it does not treat as established fact.

relations.label: uses
relations.detail: Excalibur (xcb) depends on @hraness/relay and instantiates its Convex relay modules for devices, commands, envelopes, invites, projections, and maintenance.

relations.label: runs studies with
relations.detail: Pattern Language uses ALGAL so its design experiments stay inspectable: content-addressed manifests and records you can replay.

relations.label: skills guide hosted by
relations.detail: The System One Skills guide is published at sys1.io/skills on the Sys1 site; the skill pack does not require Sys1 at runtime.

relations.label: uses
relations.detail: GhostGet Skills wraps the GhostGet CLI for catalog, plan check, invoke, read, doctor, and auth list, and pins @hraness/ghostget.

relations.label: runs programs on
relations.detail: Each GhostGet Skills workflow is an ALGAL program the ALGAL runtime executes; the package pins @hraness/algal.

relations.label: reads and sends messages through
relations.detail: Messages reach TextButler through GhostGet, a separate Mac tool you install first for messaging sign-in and permissions, and TextButler's marked replies go back the same way.

relations.label: keeps documents in
relations.detail: Sponge uses Wordcell for documents and PDF text, renders a static Wordcell edition when you publish, and can put selected documents on a wordcell.io site.

relations.label: evolves research strategies with
relations.detail: Sponge runs on ALGAL, and a candidate strategy for brief research must pass a sealed evaluation that ALGAL replays; nothing changes until you adopt it or restore the previous one.

relations.label: reaches models through
relations.detail: Sponge reaches every model through a hash-pinned Excalibur (xcb) executable, so provider sign-ins stay in xcb.

relations.label: delegates coding tasks to
relations.detail: ALGAL's xcb executor hands coding tasks to Excalibur (xcb) through its JSON run command, and ALGAL never copies credentials or reimplements account switching.

relations.label: evolves loops with
relations.detail: Soundfish's evolve command turns a loop into an evolving recipe that a bundled ALGAL evaluator, pinned by SHA-256, runs offline.

relations.label: reads compaction telemetry from
relations.detail: The aicharts collector parses Gobstopper's numeric compaction telemetry and never reads transcript content.

relations.label: records drawing runs with
relations.detail: The icon.place drawing lab runs each experiment as an ALGAL program in the browser and records the proposal, candidates, and selection as receipts it can replay; the live site does not use ALGAL yet.
